structured.reason: The description contains defensive framing of a known review complaint (category 3). Reviewers complained that the sticks are about half size and burn too briefly ("half the size of regular incense sticks," "the burn time is so short"). The description responds to that complaint with: "The shorter length also suits anyone who wants a brief, fragrant moment rather than a longer burn." This reframes the flaw as a feature in reaction to the criticism. A milder implication (category 2) also appears in "Sandalwood and cedarwood stand out most, while the softer notes add depth." Reviewers said the sage was "meh" and the myrrh lacked a strong scent, so "while the softer notes" implicitly concedes that weaker scents are a downside. The rest of the description is plain positive copy, but these phrases point to product weaknesses raised in the reviews.
